title: Chapter 272 Baldy Liu'S Uneasiness
content:
Chapter 272 Baldy Liu'S Uneasiness

The burly man with a beard looked at the few merchants in front of him who were intimidated by his majesty. I don't want to talk about the pride in my heart, but my face is serious.

"You bird people, I just want you to share a piece of news. It's not fun to spit it all out! Tell me quickly, if it satisfies me, that's all, otherwise, hehe!" After clearing his throat, the burly man said these words with malicious intent.

"Yes, yes, what the lord said is true, and the villain will say it right away!" The leader of the businessmen heard the big man let go, nodded quickly, and immediately agreed, for fear that the big man would go back on his word.

Afterwards, the leader fell silent, with a thoughtful look on his face, as if he was sorting out how to say what he wanted to say in a better and more orderly way, to satisfy the big man in front of him.

"About a month ago, the emperor of Yuguo in the north issued an order, saying that he had a peerless magic weapon, which was lost on the battlefield where Qin State fought with the coalition forces in the central region. If you hand it over to Yuguo, you will get a reward of 100,000 people from a county in Yuguo. It’s probably like this.” The business traveler had a heavy face, racking his brains to think about the incident in his memory, and then through careful The tone spoke.

"Aren't you lying to me? It's just a weapon. It's not worth such a great price!" The big man smiled disdainfully, obviously not believing what the merchant said. His hands started to move, as if he wanted to teach this madman who dared to deceive himself.

Seeing the action of the big man in front of him, the leader of the business brigade changed his face, and said quickly: "My lord, this villain did not lie to you. If you think about it, you also know that a few years ago, on the battlefield where the central coalition forces fought, Qin The country and the coalition forces in the central region have not yet fought. However, Yuguo, on the side of the coalition forces, has sent countless dark forces to search around the border between Qin and Han. blade!"

As if it was a matter of life and death, this leader seemed to be on the hook, his IQ came online, and he connected the action of Yu Guo a few years ago to this magic soldier with a big brain.

Afterwards, several people exchanged words again. The big man was persuaded, and many people who listened to the opera in the wine shop were also persuaded. They took up their own weapons passed down from generation to generation and embarked on a journey to find the magic weapon.

Not only the remote place of Chu State, but also other prosperous places, all over the Seven Kingdoms, were moved by this news and became active.

However, the manpower for this event is just some forces in the rivers and lakes, people at the bottom, people who are not satisfied with their current status and want to give it a go.

The real Seven Kingdoms officials, the manpower they sent is far less than these ordinary people. The ones that were dispatched, that is, the dark forces of some countries, did not send many forces, they just joined in the fun with the attitude of giving it a try and seeing what Yuguo really wanted to do.

...

The battlefield on the border between Qin and Han was originally a deserted and devastated place due to the cessation of the war.

Now, following the temptation of Yuguo, countless people from all walks of life have gathered, bringing deformed prosperity to this sparsely populated place.

These gangsters are not the big soldiers, or the bitterness of passers-by!

They are all fools with martial arts skills and some money in their belts.

These people, in the eyes of the owner of the small shop who specially set up stops for these people along the way, are fat sheep who can't be fatter, customers who can't be more cheerful, and the lower limit of IQ is outrageous.

One by one, in order to show off in front of the friends around them, or those tycoons next to them, to save face, it is called a generous shot, and the tip cannot be higher.

I really like the shopkeeper and the waiters in the store. The money they earn in a week is compared to the past two or three months. How can we keep them from going crazy.

Therefore, although there are some people in the Jianghu who do not have the dignity of being a strong man at all, for these roadside shop owners, they will kill them and plunder their money. But countless businessmen still rushed up like flies that smelled the fishy smell.

Today, above the border, there is such a small inn that has just been established less than a month ago. The inn is not large, but there are only a few dozen rooms. But now they are all full, even the woodsheds of the inn have been booked, and the popularity can be said to be extremely hot.

There are already hundreds of people in the inn. They gathered here, centered on this inn, and searched in a direction of more than ten to twenty miles around, showing a posture of not giving up until they reach their goals. , swore to the death to find that magic weapon.

However, the bustling and noisy environment inside the Ping An Xin Inn was gone forever, and instead fell into a deathly silence.

The high-rollers who had had such and such skirmishes in the past also stopped their movements and sat quietly on the wine table in the hall, talking to each other silently.

Finally, someone couldn't stand the long silence and spoke out.

"Liu Tuzi, you said that you took a few brothers under your command to find the whereabouts of the magic soldiers on a plain ten miles east of the inn. Is it true?"

Following his gaze, one can see that sitting in front of him is a burly man with a ferocious face and a swollen face, but with no hair on his head.

This big man was questioned by name and name, so he was naturally unhappy, but there were countless people around him looking at him, wanting to know the truth?

"Of course it is true. My brothers and I were on the plain, and we saw a red light shining from the bottom of the plain, and there was a very strong smell of blood, and in the red light, there were countless howls of innocent souls." This description is very similar to the description given by Yu Guo!" Liu Baldzi's face turned serious, and the previous anger was put away, and his face became more and more fearful as he spoke.

To be honest, when he just discovered the magic weapon before, it might be that he didn't have the idea of monopolizing the benefits, but he and his men went to dig the place where the vision appeared, and wanted to be one step ahead of others and take down this splashing sky. wealth.

However, no one expected that his subordinates would be enveloped by this red light. The initial time was not long, so it was nothing. After a long time, his eyes became red, his face was full of murderous intent, and he looked like he lost his mind, and began to kill each other.

Just like that, Liu Tuzi's original team of thirteen or four people now only has five or six people left. And he also had to confess this news, and came to cooperate with many people in the inn.

It is because Liu Tuzi understands that such a large wealth cannot be obtained by his own strength, so he can only gather all the people in the inn and try to see if it works.

If it still doesn't work, then this overwhelming opportunity has nothing to do with him, and Baldy Liu is faintly uneasy.
